EmberRim_Text_Npc0.en: Heat makes POKéMON bold. It makes\nme thirsty.
EmberRim_Text_Npc0.fr: La chaleur rend les POKéMON hardis.\nElle me donne soif.

EmberRim_Text_Npc1.en: MAGBY juggle sparks. I do not\nrecommend catching them barehanded.
EmberRim_Text_Npc1.fr: MAGBY jongle avec des étincelles.\nJe déconseille de les attraper à\lmains nues.

EmberRim_Text_Quest0_AfterT.en: The rim is warm and cozy.
EmberRim_Text_Quest0_AfterT.fr: Le bord est chaud et douillet.

EmberRim_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Two ICE HEALs would cool my pot. I\nwill pay in charcoal.
EmberRim_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Deux ANTI-GEL refroidiraient ma\nmarmite. Je paierai en charbon.

EmberRim_Text_Quest0_Done.en: Cool as snow. Take this CHARCOAL.
EmberRim_Text_Quest0_Done.fr: Frais comme la neige. Prends ce\nCHARBON.

EmberRim_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
EmberRim_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

EmberRim_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

EmberRim_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
